list.title: Spaces and plans
list.description: Upload the plan of each room, calibrate it and mark what can be used. Planners seat their guests directly on your plan.
list.emptyBody: Add the first room: a name, its real dimensions if you know them, and its drawing.

rejected.title: The last submission was not approved
rejected.next: Correct it and send it for review again.

sent.title: The plan has been sent for review
sent.body: A moderator will check it. Until then, what was approved before stays public.

pending.title: A version is waiting for review
pending.bodyNew: Sent on {date}. It becomes public once approved.
pending.bodyEdit: Sent on {date}. The current public version stays visible until approval.

details.title: Name and stated dimensions
details.body: The room's real dimensions, as you state them. If you do not know them, leave them empty: they show as “unknown”.

submit.title: Send for review
submit.bodyNew: The plan becomes public once a moderator approves it.
submit.bodyEdit: The public version stays as it is until a moderator approves the changes. Planners already using the plan receive the new version as a proposal.
submit.nothingNew: You have no changes to send.

retire.title: Withdraw “{name}”?
retire.body: The space disappears from your public page. Planners already using it keep their version.

drawing.title: 1 · The drawing
drawing.none: You have not uploaded a drawing yet.
drawing.uploadHint: PNG, JPG or PDF, 10 MB at most. A plan seen from above, with clear walls.
drawing.replaceHint: A new drawing voids the calibration and the markings made on the old one.
drawing.pdfStoredTitle: We kept the PDF, but cannot display it for calibration
drawing.pdfStoredBody: Upload the plan as an image (PNG or JPG) so you can calibrate and mark it.

calibration.title: 2 · Calibration
calibration.why: Without calibration the drawing is only a picture: it cannot take markings and planners cannot use it for seating.
calibration.scale: 1 pixel = {cm} cm. The drawing covers {width} × {height} m.
calibration.step1: Touch one end of a distance you know on the drawing (a wall, for example).
calibration.step3: Type the real distance between the two points.
calibration.mark: Mark the two points on the drawing
calibration.touchA: Touch point A on the drawing.
calibration.typed: Or type the positions of the points
calibration.typedHint: In pixels, from the top-left corner. The drawing is {width} × {height} px.
calibration.distance: Real distance between A and B (m)
calibration.distanceHint: For example 12 or 8.5. The further apart the points, the more exact the scale.

errors.points: Mark both points on the drawing first.
errors.distanceMissing: Type the real distance between the two points.

markings.title: 3 · Markings
markings.description: Every marking can be made by touching the drawing or by typing its position and size. Whatever you do not know stays “unknown”.
markings.lockedTitle: Calibrate the drawing to start marking
markings.lockedBody: Markings are kept in real metres, so they need a scale.

place.point: Touch the right place on the drawing.
place.rectFirst: Touch one corner of the rectangle.
place.outline: Touch the corners of the outline, one by one. Points: {count}

areas.title: Usable floor areas
areas.hint: The zones where tables can stand. Fit checks only look inside them.

tables.title: Table inventory
tables.hint: The table types you provide, with real dimensions and how many you have.

fixtures.title: Fixtures
fixtures.hint: Dance floor, stage, candy bar, photo booth: they have real dimensions and take part in fit checks.

pois.title: Points of interest
pois.hint: Toilets, cloakroom, bar, entrances and exits. Guests see them on the room plan.

parkingAreas.title: Parking areas
parkingAreas.hint: Drawn to scale, with their number of spaces. The number must match the one stated under parking.

fields.statedHint: Leave empty if you do not know it.
fields.xHint: Distance from the left edge of the drawing.
fields.spacesHint: Leave empty if you do not know it.
fields.rectHint: The position is that of the top-left corner.
fields.outlineHint: A free outline is changed by touching the drawing (“Free outline”).
fields.unknownHint: What you leave empty shows as “unknown”, and the table stays out of fit checks until its dimensions are known.
fields.thenPlace: After adding it, touch its place on the drawing.

parking.title: Parking
parking.description: Say what you know about parking. Each fact shows as known or “unknown” on your page and on the guests' page. If you have no parking, say so plainly.
parking.nothingPublic: You have not stated anything about parking yet.
parking.mismatchTitle: The number of spaces shows as “unknown”
parking.mismatchBody: You stated {stated} spaces, but the areas drawn add up to {drawn}. Correct one of them or confirm the stated number.
parking.pendingTitle: The parking facts are waiting for review
parking.onSiteHint: If you choose “No”, the page will plainly say “No parking on site”.
parking.countHint: Leave empty if you do not know it.
parking.countHintDrawn: The parking areas drawn add up to {drawn} spaces.
parking.confirmCount: The stated number is the right one
parking.confirmCountHint: Tick only if it differs from the {drawn} spaces drawn and you want the stated one to stand.
parking.walkingHint: On foot, in metres. Leave empty if you do not know.
parking.sent: The facts have been sent for review.

public.title: Spaces and plans
public.notCalibrated: Plan not calibrated: an indicative picture with no scale. It cannot be used for seating.

errors.measure: Type a measure in metres, for example 12 or 1.8.
errors.bothSides: Type both sides or leave both empty.
errors.notCalibrated: The drawing is not calibrated. Calibrate it before adding markings.
errors.conflict: Someone else on the team changed the plan meanwhile. We reloaded their version; make your change again.
errors.listingRetired: The listing has been withdrawn, so it can no longer take plans.
errors.tooManySpaces: A listing can have at most {max} spaces.
errors.noPicture: The drawing has no picture you can calibrate. Upload the plan as PNG or JPG.
errors.pointOutside: The points must be on the drawing.
errors.pointsTooClose: The points are too close together. Pick two points further apart.
errors.distanceTooSmall: The distance must be at least 10 cm.
errors.nothingToSubmit: Add a drawing or the room's dimensions before sending.
